subtext.hi: 52 cards ke facts yaad karo — exam mein ye har baar kaam aayenge.
subtext.en: Memorize the 52-card facts — these come up in every exam.

text.hi: Card questions probability chapter ka sabse common type hai. Ek baar 52-card facts yaad ho jaayein, to koi bhi card question 10 second mein solve ho jaata hai.
text.en: Card questions are the most common type in the probability chapter. Once you memorize the 52-card facts, any card question can be solved in 10 seconds.

content.hi: 52 cards ke important facts: 4 Suits (Spade♠, Heart♥, Diamond♦, Club♣), har suit mein 13 cards. Red = 26 (Hearts+Diamonds), Black = 26 (Spades+Clubs).
content.en: Important 52-card facts: 4 Suits (Spade♠, Heart♥, Diamond♦, Club♣), 13 cards each. Red = 26 (Hearts+Diamonds), Black = 26 (Spades+Clubs).

content.hi: Face cards = 12 (4 Jack + 4 Queen + 4 King), Red face cards = 6, Black face cards = 6. Aces = 4. Number cards (2-10) = 36. Honour cards (Ace+J+Q+K) = 16.
content.en: Face cards = 12 (4 Jack + 4 Queen + 4 King), Red face cards = 6, Black face cards = 6. Aces = 4. Number cards (2-10) = 36. Honour cards (Ace+J+Q+K) = 16.

content.hi: Do dice throw karne pe total outcomes hamesha 6×6=36 hote hain — ye number yaad rakho, bahut common hai.
content.en: When two dice are thrown, total outcomes are always 6×6=36 — remember this number, it's very common.

problem.hi: 52 cards ke deck se ek card nikala jaata hai. (i) Red king, (ii) Face card, (iii) Spade nikalne ki probability?
problem.en: One card is drawn from a deck of 52 cards. Find the probability that the card is: (i) a red king, (ii) a face card, (iii) a spade.

steps.hi: (i) Red Kings = 2 (Heart K + Diamond K). P = 2/52 = 1/26
steps.en: (i) Red Kings = 2 (Heart K + Diamond K). P = 2/52 = 1/26

problem.hi: Do dice ek saath throw kiye jaate hain. Sum (i) 7, (ii) 11, (iii) 7 ya 11 hone ki probability nikaalo.
problem.en: Two dice are thrown simultaneously. Find the probability that the sum is: (i) 7, (ii) 11, (iii) 7 or 11.

problem.hi: Ek bag mein 3 red aur 5 black balls hain. Random ball nikali jaati hai. (i) Red, (ii) Black hone ki probability?
problem.en: A bag contains 3 red balls and 5 black balls. A ball is drawn at random. Find the probability that the ball is: (i) red, (ii) black.

problem.hi: Ek game mein coin 3 baar toss ki jaati hai. Hanif jeetta hai agar sab same aaye (HHH ya TTT). Hanif ke haarne ki probability nikaalo.
problem.en: A coin is tossed 3 times in a game. Hanif wins if all three tosses give the same result (HHH or TTT). Find the probability Hanif loses.

steps.hi: Hanif jeetta hai: HHH ya TTT → 2 outcomes
steps.en: Hanif wins: HHH or TTT → 2 outcomes

question.hi: 52 cards ke deck se Red King nikalne ki probability?
question.en: Probability of getting a Red King from a deck of 52 cards?

explanation.hi: Sirf 2 Red Kings hain (Heart K + Diamond K). P = 2/52 = 1/26.
explanation.en: Only 2 Red Kings exist (Heart K + Diamond K). P = 2/52 = 1/26.
